sections.title: A family trade, *learned young*
body: The Jeweler's Loupe opened in 1987. Owner John Finley has been in the jewelry industry since the age of 15, when his father, a longtime local business owner, trained him in every aspect of the family business: jewelry repair, purchasing, marketing, customer service and management.

John credits his success to loyal customers and a great staff. Our team is experienced in the jewelry industry, and they know that customer satisfaction is the most important part of what we do. We strive to give the best service and the best prices possible.
